primitive.relation: one family over GTBase.orientations, for a simple graph G and an arbitrary Boolean relation D : rel G, each X81 / X82 helper by conversion: x8?_orientation_of D is orientation_of D (every arc joins adjacent vertices and every edge carries exactly one of its two arcs, D x y (+) D y x; so no loop and no digon); x8?_indegree D v is rel_indegree D v (the vertices u with D u v: incoming, not outgoing; a loop counts); x8?_proper_orientation D is proper_indegrees D (adjacent vertices have different indegrees, on an arbitrary D: no orientation is asserted, and a relation with a loop can be proper); x8?_proper_orientation_bound G k is proper_orientation_bound G k (one D with the three conjuncts in this order and every indegree at most k). Empty and edgeless hosts satisfy the bound at 0 through the empty relation; the bound is monotone in k with the same D. No orientation, loop, digon, nonemptiness or guard is added. Distinct and untouched: B16's diGraphType indeg (its owner keeps it), arc-set and selection indegrees (Alon-Tarsi at_indegree / at_spanning_orientation, P9 arcset_indeg) and Digraph XE2's split pair xe2_uses_only_edges / xe2_orients_edge.

edge-only-exclusive-orientation.note: orientation_of D: arcs only between adjacent vertices and exactly one direction per edge (D x y (+) D y x); no loop (orientation_of_noloop), no digon (orientation_of_nodigon); the empty relation orients an edgeless host.

incoming-cardinality.note: rel_indegree D v = #|[set u | D u v]|: incoming vertices, a loop counts; the empty relation gives 0 (rel_indegree0).

proper-indegrees.note: proper_indegrees D: adjacent vertices have different indegrees, for an arbitrary D; it does not imply orientation_of D (a loop relation on K2 is proper).

bounded-proper-orientation.note: proper_orientation_bound G k: one D, orientation_of D /\ proper_indegrees D /\ every rel_indegree D v <= k, in this order; monotone in k with the same D; 0 on empty and edgeless hosts.

upstream_audit.note: Root audit (evidence/D11-proper-orientations-discovery/upstream-audit.txt): the pinned GraphTheory sources declare no orient / indeg / in_degree; relType packages a finite Boolean relation but names no orientation of a simple graph. B16's indeg counts incoming vertices of a diGraphType and keeps its owner and interface; D11 takes a supplied relation on an independent simple-graph carrier. GTBase.orientations is not re-exported by GTBase.base.
